McpServerDefinition.description: The same two governed Apex actions the Experience Cloud workspace agent uses: resolve a contract and its Box documents, then ask Box AI about one. Box credentials stay in Apex, so a client reads contract content without ever holding a Box token.

tools.descriptionOverride: Lists CLM contracts with reference, counterparty, status, risk and value, optionally filtered by status or counterparty. Use this to answer a portfolio question, then take each reference to the contract package.
Finds a CLM contract from the reference a person used, its governed Box folder, and every document with its Box file ID. Call before asking about any document: it is the only source of file IDs.

Asks Box AI about one document of a named contract, by a Box file ID from that contract's package. A file outside that contract is refused. With itemType hub it reads the approved clause library instead.
tools.toolTitle: Ask Box AI About a Contract Document
